info.title: Reds App API: Swagger Documentation - OpenAPI 3.0
info.description:
This is a documentation page for the Reds App server-side API created by IFB398/IFB399 Team 125 based on the OpenAPI 3.0 specification.

Links:
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/VmiteOCE/IFB398-T125)

tags.name: games
tags.description: Create, delete, or modify a game

tags.name: events
tags.description: Create, delete, or modify a game event

post.description: Creates a new game in the database with an auto-incrementing ID value. Accepts JSON or URL-encoded form data.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all games stored in the database.

get.summary: Get details of an existing game
get.description: Gets the details of a game with the entered game_id.

parameters.name: game_id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the game to get details of

put.summary: Update details of an existing game
put.description: Updates the details of a game with the entered game_id. Accepts JSON or URL-encoded form data.

parameters.name: game_id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the game to update

delete.description: Deletes a game with the entered game_id. Additionally deletes all events associated with the entered game.

parameters.name: game_id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the game to delete

post.description: Creates a new game event in the database with an auto-incrementing ID value. Accepts JSON or URL-encoded form data.

get.summary: Get all game events for a specific game_id
get.description: Gets the details of a game with the entered game_id.

parameters.name: game_id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the game to get details of

get.summary: Get details of an existing game event
get.description: Gets the details of a game event with the entered event_id.

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the game event to get details of

put.description: Updates the details of a game game event with the entered event_id. Accepts JSON or URL-encoded form data

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the event to update

delete.description: Deletes a game event with the entered event_id

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the game event to delete

post.description: This can only be done by a logged in admin user.

get.summary: Get a list of all users.
get.description: This can only be done by a logged in admin user.

patch.summary: Update password or role of an existing user.
patch.description: This can only be done by a logged in admin user. Intended for use on a user management page.

delete.description: This can only be done by a logged in admin user.

post.description: Log an existing user into the system.

put.summary: Update password for the logged in user.
put.description: Only available to logged in users.

get.summary: Retrieves keybindings for the logged in user.
get.description: Returns a JSON object containing a full keymap if the user has modified any keybindings. If no keybinds have been altered, keybinds returns as null.

put.summary: Updates keybindings for the logged in user.
put.description: Takes a full keymap and saves the cusom keybinds for the logged in user.

delete.summary: Resets keybindings for the logged in user to default.
delete.description: Resets any existing keybinds, reverting the user to default settings.

get.summary: Retrieves settings for the logged in user.
get.description: Returns a JSON object containing a full settings map if the user has modified any settings. If no settings have been altered, settings returns as null.

put.summary: Updates settings for the logged in user.
put.description: Takes a full settings map and saves the cusom settings for the logged in user.

delete.summary: Resets settings for the logged in user to default.
delete.description: Resets any existing settings, reverting the user to default settings.

start_time.description: ISO string representation of game start time

game_id.description: Auto-incremented unique ID for the game

event_id.description: Auto-incremented unique ID for the event

Keybinds.description: Mapping of game events and controls to QWERTY keyboard keys

GameInputRequestBody.description: Payload required to create/update a game record

EventInputRequestBody.description: Payload required to create/update a game event

UserLoginRequestBody.description: Payload required to authenticate a user

UserCreateRequestBody.description: Payload required to create a new user

UserUpdateRequestBody.description: Payload required to update a user's password or role. Must supply username and at least password or role.

updateBoth.description: Updates both the password and role simultaneously

UserDeleteRequestBody.description: Payload required to delete a user account

UpdatePasswordRequestBody.description: Payload required to update the password of a logged in user

UpdateKeybindsRequestBody.description: Payload required to update user keybindings

UpdateSettingsRequestBody.description: Payload required to update user settings
